captions.detailed: A compact, modern travel camcorder with a matte black rectangular body and rounded corners. It features a prominent cylindrical lens barrel extending from the front, accented by a dark grey focusing ring. On its left side is a rectangular flip screen panel mounted on a vertical hinge, while three small, rectangular push buttons are integrated into the body casing just below the screen compartment. The flip screen rotates outward on its side hinge, the lens focus ring rotates continuously, and the three buttons depress independently as prismatic controls.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a consumer-scale travel camcorder. It should feature a slim rectangular body with rounded edges, a prominent front-facing cylindrical lens barrel with a focus ring, a hinged rectangular side flip screen, and three small rectangular buttons positioned below the screen opening. Ensure the screen is connected via a revolute joint, the focus ring is continuous, and the buttons are independently depressible prismatic controls.
captions.factory: Construct the camcorder body using a rounded box primitive, then subtract a rectangular pocket for the flip screen. Create the lens assembly using concentric cylinder primitives for the barrel and the focus ring. Model the flip screen as a separate thin box and connect it to the body using a revolute joint. Finally, model the three small buttons as independent box primitives aligned in the pocket and attach them to the body using prismatic joints with limited travel.
